{"id":191334,"tenderTitle":"LIGHT CONDUCTION AND DIFFUSION MATERIALS FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF LIGHT INTENSIFIED PHOTOBIOREACTORS","tenderNumber":"1-13636","tenderDescription":"ObjectivesTo increase the efficiency of photobioreactors by an improved design of light conduction anddiffusion inside the reactor.DescriptionThe need for regenerative life support systems for long term space missions necessitates a questfor increased efficiency of Photobioreactors.
